FINAL SQL:
WITH winner_counts AS (
    SELECT winner_id, winner_name, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id, winner_name
),
max_winner AS (
    SELECT winner_id, winner_name, match_count
    FROM winner_counts
    WHERE match_count = (SELECT MAX(match_count) FROM winner_counts)
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_ranking AS (
    SELECT r.player_id, r.ranking_points
    FROM rankings r
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_id, MAX(ranking_date) AS max_date
        FROM rankings
        GROUP BY player_id
    ) md ON r.player_id = md.player_id AND r.ranking_date = md.max_date
)
SELECT mw.winner_name, lr.ranking_points
FROM max_winner mw
JOIN latest_ranking lr ON mw.winner_id = lr.player_id;
